item.title: 🏙️ A Better Market East / 🚵‍♀️ Tomorrow: Spring Garden Connector Open House / 🚇 Thursday: Transit Affordability Townhall
item.description:
🏙️ A BETTER MARKET EAST

Ask for a more walkable, vibrant and dense Market East.

The City is leading an effort to revitalize Market Street, from Broad Street to the Delaware River -- and is soliciting public input.

Suggested comments:

Traffic & Transportation:

  • Prioritize roadway safety & bus users-- install curb bump-outs, raised & protected bike lanes, and prioritize bus lanes.
  • Remove one eastbound car travel lane to give space to people walking and biking.
  • Discourage curb cuts and parking decks to encourage transit use and preserve walkability.

Vacant property and open space:

  • Prioritize housing units, both affordable and market rate, to provide a stable year-round customer base for area stores and businesses.

Retail and shopping:

  • Promote ground level retail and neighborhood services, with storefronts of varying sizes and doors that open on to the street to enhance safety and walkability.

🚵‍♀️ TOMORROW: SPRING GARDEN CONNECTOR OPEN HOUSE

After years of waiting, the City is finally holding an engagement event for Spring Garden St -- spanning river to river. Attend this Streets Department Open House with us and let the city know you value safety for Spring Garden St!

Sign up on our volunteer opportunities page and we can loop you in with other supporters attending.

The Spring Garden Connector, Open House Event
Wednesday, November 19th, 5 - 8 PM
440 N. Broad St, Philadelphia, PA 19130

Read more about this project in this one-pager here.

🚇 THURSDAY: TRANSIT AFFORDABILITY TOWNHALL

This Thursday, join Councilmember Nicolas O’Rourke, Senator Nikil Saval, and Transit Forward Philadelphia for a discussion of city and state campaigns to make public transit in Philadelphia more affordable, reliable, and accessible, and how you can get involved.

Transit Affordability Town Hall
Thursday, November 20th, 5:30pm-7:00pm
Friends Center, 1501 Cherry Street

Transit Forward Philly is calling on the City to establish a Transit Access Fund to ensure that no one in Philadelphia is blocked from work, school, childcare, worship, or a doctor’s visit because of a fare or unreliable service. Sign their petition in support of a Transit Access Fund here.

🎊 HOLIDAY PARTY

Get your tickets for our holiday party!

Join us on December 12th to celebrate with other Philadelphia built environment activists, neighborhood and community leaders, architects, planners, builders, and sustainability advocates at the urbanist holiday party of the season!

We will be presenting awards to a few members of our community for their outstanding contributions to Philadelphia’s urbanist movement. Please nominate a friend or colleague who you think deserves an award for their work this year!

Nominate Your Faves


Nominations are due by Sunday, December 1st at 5pm.

👋 BECOME A MEMBER

Thank you so much to those of you who have already joined 5th Square Advocacy as a member!

Our members support our grassroots work for a more accessible, sustainable, and equitable Philadelphia. Will you join us?

As a reminder, 5th Square Advocacy is a new, separate organization from 5th Square PAC which will focus on election-related activities while 5th Square Advocacy will be the new home for our issue advocacy and legislative efforts going forward. Should you have to choose which organization to support with your membership, we highly recommend choosing 5th Square Advocacy.

📰 5TH SQUARE ADVOCACY IN THE NEWS

usa.streetsblog.org / Transit Funding in Pennsylvania Can’t Wait

🚨 ACTION ITEMS

🚉 Support the Transit Access Fund

Transit Forward Philly is fighting for a Transit Access Fund to reduce financial barriers for low-income SEPTA riders. In addition to increasing ridership, the Transit Access Fund would help stabilize SEPTA's finances and protect riders from service cuts. Sign their petition here.

🚲 Parking-Protected Bike Lane Petition

Parking-protected bike lanes are a great way to make our bikes lanes safer and lower stress, but they are illegal in PA! The Bicycle Coalition is fighting for their legalization. Sign their petition to show your support for safer bike lanes!

EVENTS

The Spring Garden Connector, Open House Event
Wednesday, November 19th, 5 - 8 PM | 440 N. Broad St
Attend this Streets Department Open House with us and let the city know you value safety for Spring Garden St!

I-95 Girard Interchange PennDOT Meeting
Wednesday, November 19th, 5-7pm | Cescaphe Ballroom, 923 N 2nd St
PennDOT is hosting a meeting for those impacted by noise from the I-95 Girard interchange from Frankford Ave to Race St

Reading Terminal Market Young Friends Taste and Tour
Wednesday, November 19th, 5-7pm | City Kitchen at Reading Terminal Market
Join Reading Terminal Market for an interactive guided tour with insider stories about the market while sampling bites from some of the market’s unique vendors. 

November Transit Day of Action: Affordability Transit Town Hall
Thursday, November 20th, 5:30pm-7:00pm | Friends Center, 1501 Cherry Street
Join Councilmember Nicolas O’Rourke, Senator Nikil Saval, and Transit Forward Philadelphia for a discussion of city and state campaigns to make public transit in Philadelphia more affordable, reliable, and accessible, and how you can get involved.

Pro-Housing Philly December Meeting w/ Senator Nikil Saval and Rep Tarik Khan
Tuesday, December 2nd, 6:30-8:30pm | Pen and Pencil, 1522 Latimer St
Join Pro-Housing Philly for their December meeting, featuring guest speakers Senator Nikil Saval and Rep. Tarik Khan. They will discuss the Harrisburg politics of housing reform and talk with the reps about the housing bills they're working on at the state level. 

5th Square Holiday Party + Annual Urbanist Awards Ceremony
Friday, December 12th at 7 PM | Indy Hall, 709 N 2nd St
Join 5th Square members and friends for our Holiday Party + Urbanist Awards Ceremony where we will be presenting awards to members of our community for their outstanding contributions to Philadelphia’s urbanist movement.

WHAT WE'RE READING

🏙️ HOUSING & LAND USE

  • Inquirer.com / City Council delays key vote on Mayor Cherelle L. Parker’s H.O.M.E. initiative, setting up tight deadline before city bond sales
  • Inquirer.com / N.J. developer plans to transform vacant North Philly warehouse into an affordable community
  • danieltrubman.substack.com / Philly’s $2 Billion Question: Why Are We Zoning Single-Family Homes Next to the Subway?
  • kevinerdmann.substack.com / I'm afraid the economy isn't improving for everyone

🌳 PUBLIC SPACE

  • Inquirer.com / Philly street festivals are shutting down over rising police overtime costs. But some groups don’t have to pay.
  • Inquirer.com / With proposed demolitions, a reinvention plan for Market Street is off to a rocky start
  • Bicycle Coalition of Greater Philadelphia / The Jersey Devil Hunt: Bikepacking by Train from Philadelphia

🚌 TRANSIT

  • Inquirer.com / No funding for SEPTA in Pa.’s $50.1 billion budget is another ‘disappointing’ blow for the agency
  • usa.streetsblog.org / Transit Funding in Pennsylvania Can’t Wait
  • Inquirer.com / SEPTA finished train car inspections, but Regional Rail commutes won’t improve right away. Here’s why.
  • The Christian Science Monitor / To a T: How Phillip Eng got Boston’s subway system back on track

🚲 MOBILITY

  • NBC10 Philadelphia / Philly mom drafts law to close loophole to hold hit-and-run drivers accountable
  • WHYY / After a stray bullet altered Amanda Parezo’s life forever, the occupational therapist is pushing to make Philadelphia more accessible for all

JOB OPPORTUNITIES

SEPTA / Project Manager - Trolley Modernization

DVRPC

  • Public Participation Task Force
  • Regional Planning Coordinator

Bicycle Transit Systems (Indego) / Bicycle Mechanic

Pennsylvania Environmental Council

  • Water Program Manager
  • Circuit Trails Coalition Manager

Econsult / Proposal Specialist

Villanova University / Project Manager - PGDC Platform Development

Yale State Capacity and Economic Dynamism Center / Post-Doc

JR Business Center / Administrative Assistant

Housing Alliance of Pennsylvania / Training and Education Director

Frankford CDC / DHCD Community Connector

Abundance Network / Founding Software Engineer

We need your support to sustain Philly's Urbanist Movement (and get cool perks)
Join us as a member TODAY! 

5th Square Advocacy is a grassroots nonprofit organization driven to advance a vision for a more accessible, sustainable, equitable Philadelphia for all residents.

Donations are not tax deductible.
